SPELL_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:SetFilterType( FILTER_TYPE_CARDS + FILTER_TYPE_PLAYERS ) filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE )
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target_creature = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) local target_player = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_PlayerPtr(0) if ( target_creature ~= nil ) then EffectSourceLKI():DealDamageTo( GetEffectX(), target_creature ) elseif ( target_player ~= nil ) then EffectSourceLKI():DealDamageTo( GetEffectX(), target_player ) end
